numberingPolicy.summary: Use simple linear numbering until a merge or split is necessary. Introduce displayNumber only when a real merge happens.
notes: Use displayNumber only when the deck genuinely merges or splits slides.
Keep numbering stable once the abstract narrative is locked.

narrativeSpine: Why this emergency medicine problem matters now.
What the audience should understand or adopt.
What action or framing should stick after the talk.

slides.title: Talk Setup
slides.purpose: Open the talk, establish speaker context, and frame the clinical problem.
slides.takeaway: Define the opening claim for the deck.
slides.figureRole: Support the opening frame or orient the audience.

slides.title: Core Argument
slides.purpose: Present the main analysis, framework, or intervention claim.
slides.takeaway: Capture the central message of the presentation.
slides.figureRole: Make the main relationship or comparison legible in one look.

slides.title: Close / Implications
slides.purpose: Land the implication, recommendation, or call to action.
slides.takeaway: Leave the audience with the change in thinking or behavior.
slides.figureRole: Reinforce the synthesis, roadmap, or closing takeaway.
